rules: waiver/exception/perf-waiver entries count only with status=active, a named owner assignee, approvers, compensating controls and an unexpired expiry
Critical security waivers need an inv64-security-contact approver in addition to the owner
no auto-renewal: extending means a new entry that references the old id; extensions are counted
entries are closed with closure_evidence, never deleted

entries.title: PK_APP_SUBMIT/1 protocol version
entries.description: v1 lacks channel binding and trace context. Accepted by negotiate() only because it still carries authn/authz.

entries.title: validate() string-list API
entries.description: Free-text list kept for 4.x callers; stable codes are only in validate_issues().

entries.title: HMAC (not public-key) signatures on in-repo release provenance when no managed signer is configured
entries.description: tools/release.py signs with an ephemeral Ed25519 key (public key published beside the artifacts) when no managed signer is supplied; that proves integrity of this bundle only, not signer identity.
entries.closure_plan: Provision a KMS/HSM or OIDC-keyless signer; pin its public key in the trust policy; re-sign.

entries.title: Validation is ~7x slower than 4.2.0 because every string is secret-scanned
entries.description: Accepted under SPECIFICATION §10 precedence (security > cost). Absolute SLO still met (validate@10 p99 well under 5 ms).
entries.closure_plan: Schema-directed scanning (scan only extension/properties subtrees) once property schemas exist.

entries.title: Isolation profile inv64-process-v1 is logical, not memory/kernel isolation
entries.description: Tenants share one interpreter. Hosts requiring hard isolation must run one process per tenant.
entries.closure_plan: Per-tenant worker processes or Wasm sandbox in the integration host.
